name: atlas-auth/atlas-php
description: Official PHP backend SDK for Atlas — the secret-key Backend API client plus session-token/JWT verification.

suggest.illuminate/support: To use the Laravel integration (Atlas\Laravel): the AtlasServiceProvider, config/atlas.php, and the atlas.auth / atlas.permission route middleware.
suggest.illuminate/http: Required by the Laravel route middleware (Atlas\Laravel\AtlasAuthenticate, RequirePermission).
suggest.symfony/security-http: To use the Symfony integration (Atlas\Symfony): the AtlasAuthenticator security authenticator and AtlasUser.
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Required to wire the Symfony bundle's services (Atlas\Symfony\DependencyInjection\AtlasExtension).
